message: We all know that feeling when our phones or tech decide to give up on us right when we need them most. 🚗 It's important to be prepared for those moments on the road, especially when it comes to our vehicles. Having a solid plan and some essential tools can make a world of difference in staying calm and safe. We can find peace in knowing that a little preparation goes a long way.
